name: Fresnel Energy LMG
description: The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management.
